summary: Iteration 349 - PDF/CSV/XLSX Export Refactor Verification. All 13 new tests PASSED, 1 skipped (pre-existing 500 bug on /resource-bookings/invoices/aggregate.pdf). The refactor extracted PDF/CSV/XLSX builders from routes/resources/_common.py into two new service modules: services/pdf_invoices.py (build_invoice_pdf) and services/csv_export.py (csv_line + build_xlsx). Legacy underscore-prefixed shims in _common.py route through to the new modules. Behavior is byte-identical to iter 348.
